text.title: FreshDrop app: the buyer books an express slot
text.uc5: Check card or SBP token (always included)
text.name: Book an express slot
text.goal: Buyer gets a delivery slot within 2 hours for tonight
text.pre: Buyer has items in the cart and a saved address
text.trigger: Buyer taps «Choose a slot» in the cart
text.success: Slot is held for 15 minutes and shown on the order
text.minimal: No slot is charged; the cart is kept
text.main: 1. Buyer opens the cart. 2. Buyer taps «Choose a slot». 3. App shows free 2-hour windows. 4. Buyer picks 19:00–21:00. 5. App holds the slot and shows the total. 6. Buyer confirms the order.
text.ext: 3a. No free slots: app offers the next day. 4a. Slot taken while choosing: app shows the free ones again. 6a. Card declined: buyer pays with SBP or changes the card.
